title: US, Ukraine teams meet in Paris to tackle 'most difficult issues' in Russia war talks
summary: US and Ukrainian negotiators meet in Paris on Wednesday for a new round of talks aimed at securing a ceasefire with Russia, with territorial disputes and the fate of the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant on the agenda.
